goal: Stop scanblocks from silently skipping unindexed blocks and falsely reporting completion
Ensure wallets and client applications are warned when scans cannot check requested ranges
reviewability: Ready for review, clean patch with passing CI that incorporates prior reviewer feedback
agreement: Broad support for eliminating silent scan failures
Requested allowing scans on indexed ranges while catching up, which author addressed (fjahr)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it fixes scanblocks silently reporting completion when blocks were skipped
Prevents wallets and applications from missing transaction matches without warning

Stops silent lookup failures from returning incomplete data while the index is syncing
